verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee returns HTML by default and documents a `return_page_markdown` parameter for markdown output, so a developer can choose between HTML and markdown. The evidence shows no plain-text or frontmatter output option and no single unified format selector. Missing for 10: documented plain-text output, frontmatter output, a general format-selection parameter, independent or hands-on corroboration of markdown output quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose exactly which output format is returned, such as markdown, HTML, text, or frontmatter

citations.quote: return_page_markdown [boolean] (false) Return the page content in markdown format
Our headless browsers will wait for the CSS / Xpath selector passed in the parameter before returning the HTML.
